snapshot.text: Free, publicly funded health system built up since independence, with heavy reliance on development partners. Timor-Leste eliminated trachoma and hosted the WHO South-East Asia Regional Committee in 2026.

priorities.title: Immunisation strategy 2026–2030
priorities.text: A new costed national immunisation strategy runs to 2030.

priorities.title: Leprosy elimination
priorities.text: The ministry is working with Mission Lepra on leprosy prevention and treatment.
